rows.text: 在载荷相同的情况下，压力升高会使轮胎压扁得较少：滚动半径通常会增大，而不是减小。
evidence: https://pure.tue.nl/ws/files/46975582/674114-1.pdf, § 4.2 e fig. 4.12 — nelle prove il raggio effettivo di rotolamento aumenta leggermente con la pressione.

rows.text: 寒冷天气不能消除充气过高的风险：压力过高会使轮胎更容易因冲击受损，并影响车辆操控。
evidence: https://www.bridgestonetire.com/content/dam/consumer/bst/na/warranties/bs_maintenance_and_safety_ca_en_2024v2.pdf, § 4 — controllare a freddo tutte le gomme, inclusa la scorta; pressione secondo il veicolo; pressione scorretta danneggia pneumatici e comportamento.

rows.text: 下坡时不要把后轮胎压力降低半巴：压力不足可能损害稳定性和抓地力。应使用符合载荷要求的压力。
evidence: https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — pressione corretta per carico e impiego; controllo a freddo; pressioni errate compromettono sicurezza, aderenza e comfort.

rows.text: 空气悬架并不要求将轮胎压力降低固定数值。应遵循适用于轮胎、载荷和使用情况的规定值。
evidence: https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — pressione corretta per carico e impiego; controllo a freddo; pressioni errate compromettono sicurezza, aderenza e comfort.

rows.text: 空气悬架不能代替轮胎检查：这类车辆也必须定期检查轮胎压力。
evidence: https://www.bridgestonetire.com/content/dam/consumer/bst/na/warranties/bs_maintenance_and_safety_ca_en_2024v2.pdf, § 4 — controllare a freddo tutte le gomme, inclusa la scorta; pressione secondo il veicolo; pressione scorretta danneggia pneumatici e comportamento.

rows.text: 充气过高通常使载荷集中在胎面中央；不能因此断定行驶后胎面边缘一定更热。
evidence: Michelin, center wear, https://www.michelinman.com/auto/auto-tips-and-advice/tire-damage/wear-problems/symptom-wear-in-center — excess inflation associates central wear; Waikato tyre-contact research printed pp.17–18 (PDF pp.30–31), https://researchcommons.waikato.ac.nz/server/api/core/bitstreams/ed1d9813-eac5-4589-ba1b-7c063f4adc71/content — racing-tyre model associates excess pressure with center contact/heating, not automatic hotter shoulders in every vehicle.

rows.text: 压力不足通常使胎肩承受更多作用并磨损得更快，而不是胎面中央。
evidence: https://www.michelinman.com/auto/auto-tips-and-advice/tire-damage/wear-problems/symptom-wear-on-both-edges — il sottogonfiaggio aumenta l’usura sulle spalle.

rows.text: 充气过高通常使载荷集中在胎面中央，因此中央比边缘更易磨损。
evidence: https://www.michelinman.com/auto/auto-tips-and-advice/tire-damage/wear-problems/symptom-wear-in-center — sovragonfiaggio concentra il carico al centro del battistrada.

rows.text: 将压力降到建议值以下并不能作为方便停车的方法：它可能增加转向所需的力，并损害车辆操控。
evidence: https://doi.org/10.4271/2016-36-0068 — prova di sterzata da fermo su autocarro: la bassa pressione aumenta le forze sullo sterzo; effetto dipendente dalle condizioni.

https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — pressione corretta per carico e impiego; controllo a freddo; pressioni errate compromettono sicurezza, aderenza e comfort.

rows.text: 在雪地上，不能仅因轮胎充气不足就认为抓地力更好：压力不足会影响车辆操控。应保持适合使用条件的规定压力。
evidence: https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — pressione corretta per carico e impiego; controllo a freddo; pressioni errate compromettono sicurezza, aderenza e comfort.

rows.text: 压力过高可能使行驶更颠簸、舒适性下降；不能说舒适性一定不变。
evidence: https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — pressione corretta per carico e impiego; controllo a freddo; pressioni errate compromettono sicurezza, aderenza e comfort.

rows.text: 题库标为错误，但在某些条件下有可能节省燃油。一项卡车研究中，较高胎压降低了滚动阻力，模型估算燃油消耗也会降低；但试验基准胎压并未确定为制造商建议值。应使用针对车辆和载荷规定的胎压。
evidence: Bachman (2018), Do Changes in Temperature and Inflation Pressure Affect Rolling Resistance During Road and Track Testing for Fuel Economy of Class 8 Tractor-Trailers?, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6198682/ — indexed full-text passage and Tables 3–4: SAE J1269 results show lower rolling resistance at 110% reference test pressure and model-estimated fuel decrease; reference test pressure not established as each vehicle manufacturer’s recommended pressure, and modeled savings not universal road proof. Direct full-text access encountered a challenge; indexed extract inspected.

Michelin, Truck and bus tyre: the right pressure, https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — choose suitable pressure for load and operating conditions; not evidence of universal fuel effect or official rationale.

rows.text: 压力过高不能保证制动距离更短：它可能降低抓地力。应保持规定压力，以保证正常制动。
evidence: https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — pressione corretta per carico e impiego; controllo a freddo; pressioni errate compromettono sicurezza, aderenza e comfort.

rows.text: 定期检查压力十分重要：压力不正确会损坏轮胎，并影响抓地力和磨损情况。

rows.text: 重型车辆轮胎应遵循轮胎制造商针对载荷和装配方式提供的指导，同时遵守车辆和轮辋的要求。

rows.text: 车轮不平衡可能造成振动和胎面不均匀磨损。动平衡可纠正车轮与轮胎总成的不平衡。

https://www.michelinman.com/auto/assistance/glossary — equilibratura dell’insieme ruota e pneumatico.

rows.text: 前束或外倾角不正确会改变轮胎与路面的接触，可能造成胎面不均匀磨损。
evidence: https://www.michelinman.com/auto/assistance/michelin-faqs — convergenza e campanatura non corrette fra le cause di usura su una spalla.

rows.text: 转向机构调整不当可能改变车轮定位，造成不均匀磨损。应检查并修正定位。
evidence: https://business.michelinman.com/tips-suggestions/truck/uneven-commercial-truck-tire-wear — usura irregolare: inflazione, assetto, equilibratura e distribuzione del carico sono possibili fattori.

rows.text: 题库标为正确：胎侧割伤可能损坏结构，需要专业检查；有些轮胎必须更换。部分商用轮胎经检查后，在明确限制内可能进行结构修复。割伤并不自动意味着可以修复，技术指南也不能确立意大利法律豁免。
evidence: USTMA, Care and Service of Commercial Truck and Bus Tires (2017), printed pp.43–44, https://www.ustires.org/sites/default/files/2024-08/Care%20and%20Service%20of%20Commercial%20Truck%20and%20Bus%20Tires%202017%20.pdf — certain sidewall section repairs possible after dismounting and qualified inspection, subject to size, location and maker; some bead-area cord damage is not repairable. US commercial-tire technical guidance, not an Italian legal exemption.

Michelin, https://www.michelinman.com/auto/auto-tips-and-advice/tire-maintenance/can-my-tire-be-repaired — passenger-car sidewall cuts require replacement in this manufacturer guidance, not universal proof for all commercial tyres.

issues.reason: Il quesito dichiara FALSO che una pressione superiore del 10% a quella consigliata permetta un risparmio di carburante. Uno studio EPA su pneumatici per trattori-rimorchi rileva invece una riduzione della resistenza al rotolamento proprio passando dal 100% al 110% della pressione di riferimento; il quesito non specifica ulteriori condizioni. È incerto come conciliare il verdetto con tale effetto fisico senza attribuirgli una premessa assente.
checked_sources: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6198682/ — studio EPA: dal 100% al 110% della pressione di riferimento la resistenza al rotolamento diminuisce nelle prove di pneumatici per veicoli pesanti.
https://doi.org/10.4271/800087 — prove SAE: la resistenza al rotolamento si riduce aumentando la pressione, con effetto decrescente.

https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — il costruttore raccomanda la pressione appropriata al carico e segnala rischi del sovragonfiaggio, senza dimostrare che esso non possa ridurre il consumo.

issues.reason: The cited UNECE thermal-study PDF returns HTTP 403; provide the exact document for independent inspection or an accessible replacement supporting the temperature-variation claim.

The source says 10% over recommended pressure permits saving, not that saving is guaranteed. Explaining only that it does not ensure a saving changes the premise. State the bounded test/model result and preserve the uncertainty that its reference pressure was not established as the manufacturer-recommended pressure; do not assert a universal absence of savings.
The cited Michelin micasset/661896 PDF returns HTTP 404; provide its exact complete version or an accessible manufacturer source for truck tyre load/pressure tables and wheel limits.

The unconditional instruction to replace every tyre with a sidewall cut and never repair it generalizes a Michelin passenger-car example to all tyres. USTMA commercial truck/bus guidance permits certain section repairs after specialist inspection, subject to injury and manufacturer limits. Distinguish the particular damage and tyre category; never claim an Italian universal repair authorization.
